item.title: Immigration officials plan to spend $38.3 billion to boost detention capacity to 92,000 beds

item.title: Ciscar, Sosa lead Hurricanes baseball to season-opening rout
item.description: Starter AJ Ciscar tossed five strong innings, and transfer catcher Alex Sosa hit a three-run home run to lead the Hurricanes to an Opening Night win over Lehigh.

item.title: Munoz, North Broward Prep stun defending state champ Somerset Canyons in 3A girls soccer regional final
item.description: Somerset Canyons lost despite having the Eagles on their heels most of the night, holding a 13-4 shot advantage.
